style: Write natural contemporary Taiwan Mandarin in Traditional Chinese, not Mainland Mandarin converted character by character. Use the restrained, precise register of a professionally edited Taiwanese science and philosophy book. Recast English and Mainland-style syntax into idiomatic Taiwan prose; avoid habitual constructions such as 對……進行……, 通過……來……, 這意味著……, 取得了巨大進展, and unnecessary 進行、使其、對於、而言、層面、給出. Prefer direct verbs and natural topic-comment order, split overlong sentences when meaning and markup allow, and avoid excessive 的、被、所、將會. Use Taiwan vocabulary where context calls for it: 資訊、資料、軟體、硬體、網路、影片、程式、電腦、記憶體、螢幕、列印、介面、元件、使用者、回饋、最佳化、雷射. Distinguish context-sensitive terms: use 質量 for physical mass but 品質 for quality; 通過 for passing a test or vote but 透過／藉由 for by means of; 程序 for a procedure but 程式 for a computer program. Use Taiwan punctuation and quotation marks 「」 and 『』 where the source markup does not already determine them. Do not become colloquial, embellish, omit, or simplify technical distinctions.
